title: Gate 9 needs a Pod-side twin - read /object_info from the wrapper to cover third-party and programmatic-INPUT_TYPES nodes
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-467 (the 1.4 smoke umbrella) - surfaced 2026-08-09 during its live Pod session, listed in tasks/MPI-467/brief.md.

MPI-467 shipped gate 9 (scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs checkRequiredInputs): it sweeps all 34 shipped graphs and diffs every Mpi* node against the REQUIRED inputs a live engine reports, refusing to answer unless the local ComfyUi-MpiNodes checkout is exactly at the node_lock pin. Verified by replaying the pre-fix graphs out of git - it flags exactly MPI-498's six nodes (nvidia_pid 1609/1618/1619/1623, flow_sdxl_4k 1603/1615) and zero against the working tree.

TWO GAPS REMAIN, both structural:

1. IT NEEDS A LOCAL ENGINE. When none answers /object_info it prints "required inputs: NOT CHECKED - ..." and never claims green (deliberate: MPI-498's trap is a gate that silently reports 0 holes). Honest, but it means the check can be skipped.

2. IT ONLY COVERS Mpi* CLASSES. Third-party packs are pinned per-node elsewhere and the LOCAL copy may differ from the Pod's, so their required sets are not evidence about what the Pod will run. A hole in a KJNodes or Impact node is invisible.

THE FIX IS THE POD ITSELF: read /object_info from the wrapper. That is authoritative for the exact commit installed, covers every class including the ~120 Mpi* nodes that build INPUT_TYPES PROGRAMMATICALLY (MpiAnySwitch, MpiAnySwitch10, MpiPacker, MpiClearVram, MpiSimpleBoolean, MpiBoolean - which is why MPI-498 insisted the gate must never parse source), and costs one HTTP call on a Pod already rented.

WHAT IT TAKES, and why it was NOT done inside MPI-467: the wrapper has NO /wrapper/object_info route (it only fetches /object_info internally, wrapper.py:555). Adding one means editing the wrapper in the mpi-ci/cubric-vision-pod repo plus a /proxy/object_info passthrough in routes/remoteProxyForward.js (mirror /proxy/queue at line 138), then ./publish-runtime.sh dev, restart the Pod, test, and promote. That is a live runtime op on shipped infrastructure, so it was left for an explicit decision rather than done unasked.

REUSE, DO NOT REWRITE: requiredInputHoles(graph, objectInfo) is already exported from scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs and is source-agnostic - it takes any /object_info map. The Pod variant is a second source for the same pure function, not a second gate. Note also that the runner is now import-safe (INVOKED_DIRECTLY guard); importing it used to run a LIVE matrix and rented an L4 by accident on 2026-08-09.
